check --help:
Usage: root check [OPTIONS] {path} {doc}                                                           
                                                                                                    
 Check one document against the code. Needs Postgres and an API key.                                
                                                                                                    
 Both producers run over whatever you name. A prose file is read by                                 
 the model, which is what you pay for, and contributes no                                           
 docstring claims. A Python file is the reverse: its whole symbol                                   
 table is checked against its docstrings for $0, no model call.                                     
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      <str>  [required]                                                                 │
│ *    doc       <str>  [required]                                                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --budget        <float>  USD ceiling. The scan stops after the document that reaches it.         │
│                          [default: 0.5]                                                          │
│ --help                   Show this message and exit.                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
dev check --help:
Usage: root dev check [OPTIONS] {path} {doc}                                                       
                                                                                                    
 Scan one document under measurement conditions — the form every published figure used.             
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      <str>  [required]                                                                 │
│ *    doc       <str>  [required]                                                                 │

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --budget                    <float>  [default: 0.5]                                              │
│ --strict-measurement                 abort loudly on a soft rail or a journal failure instead of │
│                                      producing a partial run                                     │
│ --journal-export            <str>    write the run's journal rows to this file; an aborted run   │
│                                      leaves one too                                              │
│ --max-s-candidates          <int>    per-run cap on paid adjudications; defaults to the built-in │
│                                      rail                                                        │
│ --help                               Show this message and exit.                                 │
